title: US Department of War Awards $75M Grant to Redirect EV Battery Factory to Military Drone Production
detail: The US Department of War has awarded a $75 million grant to redirect an electric vehicle battery factory toward military drone production, marking a direct militarisation of civilian battery manufacturing capacity. The move signals a deepening intersection between the civilian EV battery supply chain and defence procurement, raising questions about the long-term allocation of advanced battery manufacturing infrastructure between commercial and military applications.

media.caption: US Department of War redirects EV battery factory to military drone production with $75M grant
